ctx.x: So anyway we had an inscribed Pioneer of Jazz in Chicago or something.

Doc Souchon made the presentation. Bill Eastwood was playing banjo at that time. He played with a lot of the old time jazz guys too. But that's about the whole thing in a nutshell as far as that parade and the baseball game and the jazz presentation. But after that I lost those men. They were good musicians, they had a good band, but you can't keep a good man down. When I lose a man I say good luck to you, may you make money, and I start breaking into somebody else if I can't.

Yeah, well I remember then hearing you when you first were using Donald Sewer. Yeah. I guess right after that, sometime along in there. At some place, where was it? Was it back on Hagen Avenue? That's a lot of back. It was a little bit of speakeasy.
